objectives: Decode taught st-words by mapping graphemes from left to right.
Blend the st onset with the vowel and remaining sounds.
Distinguish st from other taught blends without guessing.
Self-correct by checking every grapheme and rereading the whole word.
concepts: Decoding maps graphemes to sounds in order.
The st onset contains s then t.
Every remaining grapheme must be decoded.
Rereading checks that no sound was omitted.

definitions.definition: A letter or group of letters representing a speech sound.
Use grapheme-sound knowledge to read a written word.
Notice and repair an error using sound and word evidence.

workedExamples.solution: Map s-t-o-p, blend the sounds, then say stop.
Keep s and t in order, then read the rest.

workedExamples.prompt: A learner reads stop as sop. What should happen?
workedExamples.solution: Return to t after s, map each grapheme, and reread stop.

commonMistakes: Guessing from the first letter only.

keyTakeaways: Keep s and t in the onset.
revisionPoints: Do not skip t after s.
